text:
Jin: Noticed a small but reproducible MT quality delta when rolling out calypso-v2-q8 on vertical ja/zh sets with ruby/zhuyin annotations. BLEU diff ~0.8 vs fp32 on the vertical subset. Artifacts: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/62411
Rosa: Can you paste a minimal repro and the tokenization diff?
Jin: Minimal repro (Japanese):
```
Input: "\u6771\u4eac\u90fd\u3000\uff08\u3042\u3044\uff09\n"
fp32 tokens: ["\u6771","\u4eac","\u90fd","\u3000","\uff08","\u3042\u3044","\uff09"]
q8 tokens:   ["\u6771\u4eac","\u90fd","\u3000\uff08","\u3042\u3044","\uff09"]  <-- unexpected merges around ideographic-space and paren
```
Marta: That looks like boundary merging triggered on quant path. Did you try running with tokenizer normalization explicit?
Jin: Ran both normalize=NFKC and normalize=None; delta persists specifically on q8 fast backend. Commands used: `python eval.py --model calypso-v2-q8 --tokenizer-args "normalize=NFKC" --input sets/vertical-ja.txt`
DevOps-bot: Canary calypso-v2-q8 deployed for eng-ml at 2026-04-02T11:02:10Z (canary c-62411)
Rosa: Try setting REDWOOD_QUANT_BACKEND=compat and REDWOOD_KERN_TRACE=1 and upload trace.
Jin: Trace snippet shows q8 path selects "pack-fuse" that runs a pre-emit grapheme windowing pass: `KERN: select(pack-fuse) -> apply: grapheme-window(2) -> emit`. Compatibility path emits before window.
Marta: If the runtime applies windowing earlier it can change byte slicing that tokenizers see. We should bisect kernel commits vs tokenizer versions. Any quick mitigation?
Rosa: We can short-circuit: set REDWOOD_QUANT_BACKEND=compatibility for canary and add rule to fallback to compat when input contains U+3000, U+200D, or U+202F.
Jin: I ran q8 + compat -> BLEU recovers to -0.2 delta. q8 fast + DISABLE_PACK_FUSE=1 -> similar recovery. Token mismatch drops from 0.9% to 0.2%.
Marta: I'll open INC-2026-1088 and CC eng-runtime + tokenizers. Action items:
- Rosa: kernel bisect and small unit test for ideographic space + parentheses (ETA 48h)
- Jin: run cross-locale smoke (zh/ja/ko) and collect token-id diffs (ETA EOD)
- Marta: stage fallback rule and monitor canary metrics (ETA asap)
DevOps-bot: Canary scaled to 15% at 2026-04-02T11:45:01Z
Rosa: Note for release notes: mention quant pack-fuse ordering change and impact on ideographic whitespace, ruby/furigana, and ZWJ sequences.
Jin: Will attach diffs and a short repro script. Thanks all :pray:
